title: Unsigned right shift of Number is fixed to 32 bits
summary: >>> Treat the left operand as a 32-bit unsigned integer, using only the lower 5 bits for the shift count.
boundary: This operator does not support BigInt; the high-order bits of Numbers larger than 32 bits are lost on conversion.
relevance: When interpreting bit-mixing transformations in scripts, avoid miscalculations at high bits or at the 32nd shift.
